sessions.value:
# Starting and finishing

## A Starting

**PROMISING START FOR AMBROSE**

Sally Ambrose, Britain’s best hope in this year’s Eurotennis tournament, **made a promising start** when she won her first match today against Sweden’s Ulla Hemvik.

**EARLY START TO HOLIDAY**

Many people have decided to **make an early start** to the bank holiday weekend. **Traffic was already building up** on major motorways on Thursday evening.

**ABSOLUTE BEGINNERS MAKE BEST LANGUAGE LEARNERS**

Research shows that **absolute beginners** have a better chance of learning a language well than those who **start with some knowledge**.

**ARTS FESTIVAL GETS OFF TO A GOOD START**

The Glasgow Arts Festival **got off to a good start** this week, attracting more than 120,000 visitors during its first three days.

sessions.description_vi: Các cách diễn đạt liên quan đến việc kết thúc.
sessions.value:
## B Finishing

**CLOSE FINISH IN SPANISH RALLY**

Pedro Macarro emerged the winner of today’s Spanish Grand Prix in a very **close finish**. Macarro was just 0.5 seconds ahead of Finland’s Pekka Hirvonen.

**ROUX JUST WINS**

Claude Roux won the championship yesterday in a **nail-biting finish**.

**NEW CONSTITUTION**

Ministers met in Rome today to **put the finishing touches** to a new constitution for the European Union.

**NEW HEALTH CONTRACT BRINGS STRIKE TO AN END**

The doctors’ strike was finally brought to an **end yesterday** when the union and management signed an agreement over pay and working hours.

sessions.title: C More collocations for starting and finishing
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm từ khác liên quan đến bắt đầu và kết thúc.
sessions.value:
## C More collocations for starting and finishing

The invention of television **marked the beginning of the end** for popular radio shows.
I studied hard for a whole month and the **end result** was that I got a grade ‘A’ in the exam.
The meal we had on our last evening in Istanbul was a **perfect end** to our holiday.
It’s two o’clock. **Let’s make a start / get started, shall we?** Then we can finish by five.
As my time at university **came to an end**, I knew I had to start looking for a job.
The meeting **drew to a close** at 5.30, after a long discussion.
Without any warning, he was fired from the newspaper in 2014. It was an **abrupt end** to his career in journalism.

**Common mistakes**

We say that a **holiday ended**, **journey ended**, **trip ended**, **meal ended**, NOT finished.

senses.definition_vi: Bắt đầu một cách thuận lợi, có triển vọng tốt.
examples: Sally Ambrose made a promising start in the Eurotennis tournament.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng để nói về sự khởi đầu của một sự kiện, một cuộc thi đấu, hoặc một dự án.

use_prompts.question: How did your favourite team begin the season?
How has a new colleague settled into your workplace?
How did you find your first weeks at university?

dictation.text: The new manager made a promising start this year.

paraphrase.source: Sally began the tennis tournament very well.
paraphrase.model: Sally made a promising start in the tennis tournament.

paraphrase.source: The new teacher's first weeks were very good and suggested future success.
paraphrase.model: The new teacher made a promising start.

image.value: A car on a road at sunrise

senses.definition_vi: Bắt đầu làm gì đó sớm hơn bình thường, đặc biệt là vào buổi sáng hoặc trước một dịp đặc biệt.
examples: Many people decided to make an early start to the bank holiday weekend.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng khi muốn tránh tắc nghẽn giao thông hoặc để có nhiều thời gian cho một hoạt động.

use_prompts.question: How do you avoid traffic on a long journey?
What helps people get more done in a day?
Is it healthy to get up very early?

dictation.text: We should make an early start tomorrow morning.

paraphrase.source: Many people left very early to begin the holiday weekend.
paraphrase.model: Many people decided to make an early start to the bank holiday weekend.

paraphrase.source: If we leave at dawn, we will avoid the traffic.
paraphrase.model: If we make an early start, we will avoid the traffic.

image.value: A long line of cars on a highway

senses.definition_vi: Tình trạng giao thông bắt đầu trở nên đông đúc, xe cộ bắt đầu ùn tắc.
examples: Traffic was already building up on major motorways on Thursday evening.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả sự gia tăng dần dần của lượng xe cộ trên đường.

use_prompts.question: What problems do people face when travelling before a public holiday?
Why do many workers leave the office early on Fridays?

paraphrase.model: When we left home, traffic was already building up on the motorway.

paraphrase.model: The yoga class is for absolute beginners.

image.value: A person reading a book with a thoughtful expression

senses.definition_vi: Bắt đầu một việc gì đó khi đã có một ít hiểu biết hoặc thông tin ban đầu.
examples: Absolute beginners have a better chance than those who start with some knowledge.

paraphrase.model: Some learners start the course with some knowledge.
